html_title: StreetZim — Ol map ofline bilong Kiwix
meta_description: Ol fri map bilong OpenStreetMap i wok ofline insait long Kiwix. Vekta tail, piksa bilong satelait, graun 3D na save bilong Wikipedia — i wok taim i no gat intanet long iOS, Android, Mac, Windows na Linux.
tagline: Ol map bilong OpenStreetMap i wok ofline insait long Kiwix. Vekta tail, piksa bilong satelait, graun 3D na Wikipedia — yu no nidim intanet.
maps_intro: Makim wanpela rijen daunbilo, putim Kiwix long masin bilong yu, na opim .zim fail. Ol fail i stap long Internet Archive — olgeta daunlod i gat torrent tu.
maps_intro_lang: Makim wanpela rijen daunbilo na daunlodim long Tok Pisin: ol nem long map, painim na Wikipedia i stap long Tok Pisin. Opim fail long Kiwix, em wanpela fri app; pes bilong wan wan map i soim yu olsem wanem, step long step.
feature_key_intro: Ol mak long wan wan kat i soim wanem samting i stap insait:
badge_overture_desc: ol websait, fon namba na sosel midia bilong Overture,
badge_photo_desc: painim wanpela ples long piksa bilong wanpela sain.
updated_line: Las taim ol i stretim: {updated} · bil
filter_aria: Painim insait long lis bilong ol map
what_lead: StreetZim i putim data bilong OpenStreetMap — ol kantri o ol kontinen olgeta — insait long wanpela ZIM fail tasol, na yu ken opim long Kiwix. Em i wok ofline olgeta: i no gat seva, i no gat API, na yu no nidim intanet bihain long namba wan daunlod.
what_p2: Planti ofline map app i save yusim raster tail; StreetZim i yusim vekta tail em masin bilong yu yet i droim wantaim MapLibre GL JS. Olsem na map i ran isi taim yu surikim, bikim na tanim, na i gat graun 3D tu — olgeta i kam long wanpela fail tasol long masin bilong yu.
feat_vector_p: Ol map i klia na i ran isi i go inap long ol rot, wantaim OpenMapTiles skima, na MapLibre i droim long dispela taim stret.
feat_sat_p: Ol piksa bilong Sentinel-2 i no gat klaut, 10 mita long wan wan piksel, bilong olgeta hap bilong map.
feat_terrain_p: Sado bilong maunten na hait bilong graun long 3D, i kam long Copernicus GLO-30 DEM bilong olgeta hap bilong graun.
feat_wiki_p: Presim wanpela siti, maunten o biknem ples na lukim stori bilong en long Wikipedia wantaim ol bikpela save.
feat_search_p: Painim insait long planti milion nem bilong ol ples, rot, pak, het bilong maunten, ples balus na ol narapela ples.
feat_offline_p: Wanpela .zim fail tasol. I no gat akaun, i no gat wanpela i bihainim yu, i no gat intanet. Opim na go.
step1_p: Wanpela fri app bilong iOS, Android, Mac, Windows na Linux. Kisim long kiwix.org. Long Windows na Linux, opim ol map long Kiwix PWA long nau: Kiwix Desktop 2.5 i soim ol map i stap nating, na rot bilong stretim dispela i stap yet long ol nightly build tasol.
step2_p: Makim wanpela rijen antap na daunlodim .zim fail (o kisim torrent sapos yu laik em i go hariap moa).
step2_p_lang: Makim wanpela rijen antap na presim baten bilong daunlod: yu kisim map long Tok Pisin, long wanpela .zim fail.
step3_p: Opim .zim fail long Kiwix. Em tasol — map i wok ofline olgeta.
sources_h2: Ol as bilong data na ol laisens
sources_intro: StreetZim i wokim olgeta samting long open data tasol. Wan wan ZIM map i gat ol samting i kam long ol dispela as:
src_map: Data bilong map: © Ol lain i wok wantaim OpenStreetMap, i stap aninit long Open Database License (ODbL).
src_sat: Piksa bilong satelait: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021) — CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, long wok i no bilong bisnis tasol.
src_elev: Hait bilong graun: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, ol i givim aninit long COPERNICUS bilong Yuropian Yunion na ESA.
src_place: Save long ol ples: Wikidata (CC0) na Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
oss_intro: StreetZim i save yusim ol Kiwix app bilong opim ol .zim fail. Olgeta i open source na ol i wokim long GitHub:
footer: StreetZim em wanpela open source projek. Sos kod i stap long GitHub. Ol map i stap long Internet Archive.
tier_continent: Ol kontinen na ol bikpela hap wankain
tier_multi_country: Ol rijen i gat planti kantri
card_preview_title: Lukim dispela map long brausa bilong yu, i kam stret long archive.org
card_languages_title: Dispela map wantaim ol nem na Wikipedia long narapela tok ples, brausa bilong yu i bungim
card_download_lang_title: Dispela map wantaim ol nem, painim na Wikipedia long Tok Pisin, long wanpela .zim fail
card_original_title: Map olsem ol i wokim: ol nem bilong ples i stap long tok ples bilong hap; ol baten na Wikipedia i stap long Tok Inglis
card_no_lang: I no stap yet long Tok Pisin: dispela map i gat ol nem bilong ples long tok ples bilong hap, na ol baten i stap long Tok Inglis.
mp_meta_description: Fri ofline map bilong {name} bilong Kiwix app: ol rot, ol ples, painim, rot bilong go na Wikipedia, long Tok Pisin. I wok taim i no gat intanet long Android, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows na Linux.
mp_lead: Wanpela fri map bilong {name} i wok taim i no gat intanet, insait long Kiwix app.
mp_feat_search: Painim ol rot, adres na ples.
mp_feat_nav: Rot bilong wokabaut, baisikel na ka, masin bilong yu yet i wokim.
mp_feat_overture: Ol stoa, haus kaikai na ol narapela ples wantaim websait na fon namba bilong ol.
mp_feat_terrain: Ol liklik maunten na ol maunten long 3D.
mp_feat_satellite: Piksa bilong satelait bilong olgeta hap bilong rijen.
mp_feat_wiki: Ol stori bilong Wikipedia long ol siti, biknem ples na ol ples bilong lukim.
mp_feat_photo: Painim wantaim piksa: kisim piksa bilong wanpela sain na painim dispela ples long map.
mp_dl_lang_note: Ol nem long map, painim na Wikipedia long Tok Pisin, long wanpela fail bilong Kiwix.
mp_dl_original_note: Map olsem ol i wokim: ol nem bilong ples i stap long tok ples bilong hap; ol baten na Wikipedia i stap long Tok Inglis.
mp_dl_preview: Lukluk pastaim long map long brausa bilong yu
mp_space_note: Pastaim long yu daunlodim, sekim sapos masin bilong yu i gat inap spes. Ol bikpela map i gutpela long daunlodim long Wi-Fi.
mp_updated: Data bilong map i kam long {date}.
mp_other_langs_h2: Dispela map long ol narapela tok ples
kg_h2: Olsem wanem long opim map long Kiwix
kg_android_1: Putim Kiwix long Google Play. Em i fri.
kg_android_2: Daunlodim map antap. Fon bilong yu i putim long Downloads.
kg_android_3: Opim Kiwix, go long laibreri bilong en na putim fail yu daunlodim pinis.
kg_ios_1: Putim Kiwix long App Store. Em i fri.
kg_ios_2: Daunlodim map antap. Safari i putim long Files app, aninit long Downloads.
kg_ios_3: Opim Kiwix, go long laibreri bilong en na opim fail long Downloads.
kg_mac_1: Putim Kiwix long Mac App Store, na bihain opim fail yu daunlodim pinis wantaim em.
kg_pc_1: Opim Kiwix web app long brausa bilong yu na makim fail yu daunlodim pinis. Kiwix Desktop 2.5 i soim ol dispela map i stap nating; rot bilong stretim i stap yet long ol nightly build tasol.
kg_offline: Bihain long dispela, map i wok taim i no gat intanet.
hero_h1: Ol map i wok taim i no gat intanet
hero_apps: I op long fri app Kiwix:
tour_lead: Olgeta samting long ol dispela vidio i ran long wanpela fail tasol long masin. Ol i rekodim taim intanet i pas; ol liklik tok na ol dot i makim wan wan pres tasol ol i putim bihain.
tour_photo_h: Kisim piksa bilong sain, painim ples
tour_photo_p: Kisim piksa bilong wanpela sain bilong rot, pes bilong wanpela stoa o adres long ki kat bilong hotel, na map i painim ples em sain i kolim. Masin bilong yu yet i ridim ol tok, long rait em ol i raitim long en: hia i gat Yukren, Grik, Arabik, Japan, Korea, Sainis na Inglis, i sanap wantaim.
tour_photo_note: Long ol map i gat dispela mak.
tour_zoom_h: Long siti olgeta i go inap long wanpela haus
tour_zoom_p: Ol vekta map i stap klia long olgeta zum: flai long Kyiv olgeta i go daun long wanpela haus, na bihain slipim na tanim map.
tour_drive_p: Wanpela rot i brukim Kyiv, fon i wokim na map i bihainim long olgeta tanim. Ol i rekodim wantaim giaman ples bilong fon; namel bilong ron i ran tenpela taim hariap.
tour_terrain_p: Sado bilong maunten, graun 3D na piksa bilong satelait: ol maunten antap long Tehran.
tour_signs_p: Wankain painim long wan wan rait, long map bilong siti em sain i sanap long en.
tour_credits: Ol piksa bilong sain, piksa bilong dua na ol piksa bilong satelait long ol dispela vidio na piksa em wok bilong ol narapela man: lukim ol nem bilong ol man i wokim piksa na ol laisens.
gallery_lead: Ol trupela skrin bilong ol map, long kompyuta na long fon. Makim wanpela bilong lukim bikpela, na bihain go long ol narapela.
gal_city: Wanpela siti olgeta long wanpela fail
gal_building: I go daun long wan wan haus, long 3D
gal_place: Kat bilong ples wantaim piksa na sotpela stori bilong Wikipedia
gal_find: Painim ol haus kopi, stoa na ol narapela samting klostu
gal_route: Wanpela rot em fon i wokim
gal_turns: Gaid long olgeta tanim, olsem lis
gal_wiki_layer: Ol stori bilong Wikipedia long map
gal_photo: Painim wantaim piksa i ridim wanpela sain
langs_h2: Map long tok ples bilong yu
langs_lead: Ol nem bilong ples, painim, gaid long rot, ol stori bilong Wikipedia na ol menyu bilong map yet, long tok ples yu save ridim. Ol rait i go long han kais tu.
langs_step1_p: Makim long lis daunbilo, o long menyu antap long olgeta pes.
langs_step2_h: Daunlodim map long dispela tok ples
langs_step2_p: Long pes bilong tok ples bilong yu, bikpela baten long wan wan map i daunlodim map long dispela tok ples, long wanpela .zim fail. Dispela pes long Tok Inglis i givim wan wan map olsem ol i wokim: ol nem bilong ples long tok ples bilong hap, ol baten na Wikipedia long Tok Inglis.
langs_step2_p_lang: Long dispela pes, bikpela baten long wan wan map em “Daunlodim long Tok Pisin”: map wantaim ol nem bilong ples, painim, Wikipedia na ol menyu long Tok Pisin, long wanpela .zim fail. Sapos wanpela map i no redi yet long Tok Pisin, kat bilong en i tokim yu.
langs_step3_p: Planti map inap kamap long ol tok ples ol manmeri i save yusim long hap, olsem Katalan long Spen na Potugal o Wels long Briten na Aialan. Ol map long ol narapela tok ples i soim olgeta tok ples bilong olgeta map na i bungim fail insait long brausa bilong yu.
langs_demo_note: Wankain map bilong Kyiv long Arabik, Hibru, Hindi, Tai, Japan na Sainis. Sapos wanpela nem i no gat tanim tok, em i stap olsem ol i raitim long hap.
langs_grid_note: Namba i soim hamas map i redi long dispela tok ples tude.
filter_none: I no gat map i wankain long dispela. Traim wanpela kantri, rijen o siti.
credits_h: Ol piksa long ol vidio na piksa bilong skrin
credits_intro: Ol vidio na piksa bilong skrin i soim ol map olsem ol i stap tru. Ol sain long painim wantaim piksa, wanpela piksa bilong biknem ples na ol piksa bilong satelait em wok bilong ol narapela man, na mipela i yusim aninit long ol dispela laisens. Mipela i katim ol piksa bilong sain.
